### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #15795

Problem Summary:



### What is changed and how it works?

What's Changed:

Added two APIs `CreateSchemaWithInfo` and `CreateTableWithInfo` to `ddl.DDL`, so that tools which use TiDB as a library can create databases/tables/views/sequences safely and directly from the `*model.DBInfo`/`*model.TableInfo`.

How it Works:

The existing `CreateSchema` and `CreateTable`/`CreateView`/`CreateSequence` functions work by validating the ASTs, and create the `*model.DBInfo`/`*model.TableInfo` before delivering the DDL job. 

This PR moves the info creation before validation, and put the validation into the new `CreateSchemaWithInfo`/`CreateTableWithInfo` functions. 

This change propagates downwards where several helper functions relying on ASTs are now changed to relying on the models.

issue_context.title: Add interface method (ddl.DDL).CreateTableByInfo
issue_context.body:
## Development Task

Add the following two method to the [`ddl.DDL` interface](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/master/ddl/ddl.go#L78):

```go
// CreateSchemaWithInfo creates a database (schema) given its database info.
// If `ifNotExists` is true, this method does nothing when a database of the
// same name already exists. Otherwise `ifNotExists` is false, returns an error.
// If `tryRetainID` is true, this method will try to keep the database ID
// specified in the `info` rather than generating new ones. This is just a hint
// though, if the ID collides with an existing database a new ID will always be
// used.
CreateSchemaWithInfo(
    ctx sessionctx.Context, 
    info *model.DBInfo, 
    ifNotExists bool, 
    tryRetainID bool) error

// CreateTableWithInfo creates a table, view or sequence given its table info.
CreateTableWithInfo(
    ctx sessionctx.Context, 
    info *model.TableInfo, 
    ifNotExists bool, 
    tryRetainID bool) error
```

To directly construct a table given its info. Since `CreateTable` etc already performed the conversion-to-info before sending out the job, the effort needed to support these APIs should be minimal.

These two functions are intended to be used by tools which embed TiDB as a library, including BR, Lightning and DM (schema tracker). This is intended to solve at least the following without changing the parser syntax:

* #14030
* pingcap/br#215

Furthermore, it is also a performance improvement since these tools natively receive a `*model.TableInfo` rather than a `*ast.CreateTableStmt`, so we could avoid the (ConstructResultOfShowCreateTable → Parse → buildTableInfo) round trip.
